title: test(qa-scenarios): add the travel_expense mid-tier scenario card
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiNjyvCdXYygFqntMNR7S2dW)_
Fixes #30476
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:新增「差旅报销」中档场景卡(7 个对象、两级审批、3 个角色其中 2 个按行限定、1 个支出报表、120 张报销单跨 7–10 月、10 道问数、6 个写操作、4 个 agent 动作),并配一份只属于这张卡的真值测试。
- **为什么改**:落实 cloud#3600 九个场景中的财务场景,让 AI 建应用、问数、代办写操作都有一张能用代码判分的差旅报销卡。
- **风险与回滚**:只加测试数据和测试,所在包私有、不发布,运行时零改动;回滚即删两个新文件并还原 `library.test.ts` 一行。
- **先看**:① `docs/qa/scenarios/travel_expense.json` 的 `run.questions` 与 `run.operations`;② `packages/qa/scenarios/test/travel-expense.test.ts` 的 `EXPECTED_TRUTHS`;③ `packages/qa/scenarios/test/library.test.ts` 第 102 行(控制卡清单加了本卡)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios test`,预期 4 个测试文件、64 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `docs/qa/scenarios/travel_expense.json` (new): the 差旅报销 travel-expense mid-tier card.
  - Seven objects: `department`, `employee`, `travel_standard` (a cap per grade and expense type), `trip_request`, `expense_claim`, `claim_line` and `approval_step` (the two-step approval: department manager, then Finance).
  - Three personas: `employee` (own rows) and `dept_manager` (own department) carry a row scope; `finance_officer` sees every claim but no trip request.
  - Seed: 120 claims dated July to October 2026, plus 280 lines, 204 approval steps and 126 trips. The arithmetic rule that generated it is stated in the card's `$comment`, so every truth can be worked by hand.
  - Run half: 10 questions, 6 operations and 4 agent actions (one confirm-gated); `iterate` adds travel advances.
- `packages/qa/scenarios/test/travel-expense.test.ts` (new): this card's own test file.
  - It pins all 10 computed truths and the 7 per-persona truths against hand-worked values.
  - It asserts the mid-tier floor and the seed's own consistency: each claim total is the sum of its lines, and a line is `over_standard` exactly when it is above the grade cap.
  - It shows that a wrong seed cell or a wrong truth spec in a fixture copy goes red against those pins.
- `packages/qa/scenarios/test/library.test.ts`: one line. The library-wide test asserts the exact set of loaded card ids, so `travel_expense` is added to that list. Its truths are pinned in the card's own file, not here.

## Tests

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios test`: 4 files, 64 tests passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios typecheck`: exit 0, after building the closure with `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/scenarios^...' build`.

## Acceptance notes

- **File name.** The card is `travel_expense.json`, not `travel-expense.json` as the issue spells it. A card's `id` must be a snake_case machine name, and the loader requires it to equal the file's basename, so a hyphenated basename cannot load. The schema was not changed.
- **No schema field for some floor items.** Three floor items have no field in the schema:
  - an approval or automation flow as a structural expectation;
  - "declarative preferred";
  - a report as distinct from a dashboard.

  The card states them in `prompt.detailed` (zh and en) and in `capabilities`, seeds `approval_step` as an expected object, and declares the report under `expect.dashboards`. Nothing in the loader grades them.
- **Seven operation kinds, six operations.** The issue names seven operation kinds and caps the card at six operations. So `file_and_submit_from_text` covers two of them: entry from free text with lines, and the multi-step chain (file, add two lines, submit, route to the manager).
- **Routed approval step not asserted.** The post-state of `file_and_submit_from_text` does not assert the routed step-1 row. A `where` cannot name the new claim's id, and `step 1 · approver e01 · pending` also matches a seeded row.
- **README step 3.** `docs/qa/scenarios/README.md` "Adding a card" step 3 says to add a card's truths to `test/library.test.ts`, but this card's truths live in its own file. The README is unchanged here.
- **Sibling cards.** Every sibling mid-tier card has to edit the same `library.test.ts` line, so their PRs will conflict on it in turn.
- **Unreachable references.** `objectstack-ai/templates` and `objectstack-ai/cloud` answer 403 from this session. The domain is designed from the card text alone, and the rulings are applied as the card states them.
